profiles.6523: PHC Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare digital and precision technology solutions in Japan, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates in three segments: Diabetes Management, Healthcare Solutions, and Diagnostics & Life Sciences. It offers precision anatomical pathology for cancer, including tissue processors, digital pathology, and histology consumables; cell growth and preservation, such as CFC-free ultra-low temperature freezers, CO2 incubators, and live cell metabolic analyzer and cell expansion bioreactor system; and diagnostic testing comprising clinical testing, diagnostic reagents, and digital diabetes management solutions. The company also provides patient record and billing solutions, which include electronic medical record systems and receipt systems, systems for pharmacies, and wellness and prevention; diabetes management technology, such as blood and continuous glucose monitoring systems; and medical device and drug delivery comprising contract development and manufacturing services, drug delivery systems, and digital health. It serves patients, healthcare professionals, and researchers. The company was formerly known as Panasonic Healthcare Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to PHC Holdings Corporation in April 2018. PHC Holdings Corporation was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

profiles.4526: Riken Vitamin Co., Ltd. engages in the food ingredient, food and chemical improving agents, health care, consumer and commercial products, and vitamins businesses in Japan. The company also provides food improving agents, including food emulsifiers, processed oils, natural colorants, and vitamin E, emulsification, anti staling, foaming, coagulation, anti-sticking, texture improvement, coloring, nutritional enhancement, and antioxidant to food manufacturers; and chemical improving agents for anti-fogging, plasticization, lubrication, anti-static, thickening, cleaning, mold release, dispersion, and antioxidant. In addition, it offers health care products comprising crocetin, a natural yellow colorant; mekabu fucoidan, a viscous ingredient; carotenoids; vitamin; and improving agents, such as pork extract. The company was formerly known as Riken Vitamin Oil Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Riken Vitamin Co., Ltd. in 1980. Riken Vitamin Co., Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.9601: Shochiku Co., Ltd. engages in audio and video, theatre, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Video-related business, Theater Business, Real Estate Business, and Other segments. The company is involved in the production, sales, distribution, and exhibition of theatrical films, operation of movie theater concession stands, and licensing of video rights, produces and sells TV movie, commercial planning and production, BS/CS/CATV software production and editing, tar-based and general broadcasting, production, acquisition and sales of video software, planning and production agency for advertising, music writing. It also plans, produces and stages theatrical performances, brokers actors and talents, manufactures, buys, sells and leases stage costumes, sound equipment for theatrical productions, and provides in-theater earphone guide services. In addition, it develops, manages, and leases building, as well as engages in real estate management and cleaning. Further, it provides program production and sales, planning and sales of character goods, and planning and production of distribution content. The company was formerly known as Shochiku Kinema Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shochiku Co., Ltd. in 1937. Shochiku Co., Ltd. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.4658: Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. provides general building facility maintenance services in Japan and internationally. The company develops equipment maintenance plans; maintenance and management/maintenance and renewal; diagnosis and evaluation of equipment; and validation support. It also offers radiation dose measurement; measurement of radioactive material concentration in wastewater; as well as technical training services. Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
profiles.6235: Optorun Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells optical thin film equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, Vietnam, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers ion source beam assisted deposition system, including optical thin film coaters, super multilayer optical coaters, and optical thin film coater for mass production; reactive plasma deposition system; metal mode sputtering system, such as optical thin film and optical wafer level sputtering coaters; and plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition system. It also provides iron sources; and optical monitors. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacturing, distribution, import, and export of vacuum coating machines, peripheral equipment, and units using vacuum coating products; and provision of maintenance and consulting services. Its products are used in clean energy, display, optical communications, semiconductor, optical storage media, bio-industry, consumer products, and vehicle-mounted device applications. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tsurugashima, Japan.
profiles.4064: Nippon Carbide Industries Co., Inc. engages in the electronic and functional products, and films and sheeting business in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers functional chemicals for electronic materials, coating materials, agrochemicals, metal surface treatment agents, pharmaceutical products, and biochemistry; and functional polymers, including thickening and adhesive agents, resin for dyes and coating materials, and melamine resin for tableware. It also provides semiconductor mold cleaners and conditioners; and ceramic substrates, such as alumina substrates, thick-film printing substrates, and green sheetings. In addition, it offers marking films, laser markable labels, and packaging materials; graphic and 3D-emblem stickers; retroreflective sheetings, aluminum connected sign substrates, and aerial display reflectors. Nippon Carbide Industries Co., Inc. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.5032: ANYCOLOR Inc. operates as an entertainment company in Japan and internationally. It produces NIJISANJI, a VTuber/Virtual Liver project; and other VTuber projects. The company provides management services for the virtual livers; and creates live2D and 3D NIJISANJI models, as well as develops products for site creation, web and smartphone applications, in-company systems, etc. It offers content creation, event hosting, and promotion plans to corporations, governments, and other organizations. ANYCOLOR Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.8600: TOMONY Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides various banking and financial products and services. It manages banks and other companies. The company also offers computer-related work; outsourcing, agency services, and temporary staffing; credit guarantee; renewable energy generation and sales business and energy storage; cash processing and cash transfer; leasing; and handball-related operations. TOMONY Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.
profiles.3109: Shikibo Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and markets textile products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Textiles; Industrial Materials; Functional raw materials; and Real Estate and Services. The company offers various yarns, fabrics, textiles, knitwear, and secondary products used for general clothing, shirts, sportswear, casual wear, and uniform, as well as bed and bedding. It also provides industrial materials, such as dryer canvas used for paper, cardboard, and food production, as well as filter clothes; and composite materials comprising fiber reinforced materials, glass fiber reinforced plastics, carbon fiber reinforced plastics, and others; and industrial adhesive for electronic boards production. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacture, processing and marketing of various textile and chemical industry products; and transactions, leasing, and management of real estate, as well as rental of commercial buildings, apartments, mixed bathing facilities, warehouses, and logistics; operation of Shikibo Hall; supply of linen to hotels and home cleaning; distribution businesses; and engages in solar power generation. It exports its products. Shikibo Ltd. was incorporated in 1892 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
profiles.6472: NTN Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells bearings, products, and CVJ axle products in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers rolling bearings, including radial and thrust ball, radial and thrust roller, special purpose, and linear motion bearings; plummer blocks; bearing units; sliding bearings; constant velocity joints; auto tensioners; clutches; electric motors and actuators; sensor related products; parts feeders; condition monitoring systems; sintered machine parts; and power generators. It also provides aftermarket parts and maintenance services. The company serves automobile and motorcycle, electric vehicle, railway vehicle, wind turbines, construction and mining machinery, agricultural machinery, office equipment, iron manufacturing machinery, food machinery, machine tools, paper manufacturing machinery, food machinery, aerospace, medical equipment, precision equipment, robots, electrical machinery, vacuum and clean, gear reducer, and green energy products markets. NTN Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
profiles.6167: Fuji Die Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of wear-resistant tools in Japan and internationally. The company provides die and plug; rolls; motor core, power compacting, and battery-related mold; car manufacturing, kneading and extruding, cold forgiving, precise cutting, steel, ceramic, and tungsten-based alloy tool. It offers tools for drawing, extruding, and rolling processes, which are used in transportation machinery, construction materials, and infrastructure-related facilities; tools and dies for manufacturing beverage and food cans; molds for manufacturing optical elements; forging molds and tools; and high-pressure tools, as well as cemented carbide for motor lamination stamping and nano grade cemented carbide. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.8179: ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates a chain of restaurants in Japan. It operates through Restaurant Business; Contract Business; Hotel Business; Food Business; and Others segments. The company operates restaurants under the Royal Host, TENYA, Sizzler, Shakey's, Royal Garden Cafe, Mrs. Elizabeth Muffin, and Standard Coffee brands; beer restaurants, cafes, and various specialty shops; and hotels under the Richmond Hotel brand. It is also involved in food manufacturing, purchasing, distribution, logistics, and other infrastructure-related functions; and manufacture of frozen meals under the Royal Host Deli brand, as well as meals for sale by large retailers and other companies. In addition, it develops and operates various eating and drinking establishments on a contractual basis at airport terminals, highway service and parking areas, convention centers, office buildings, medical and nursing facilities, department stores, and government offices. Further, it offers in-flight catering and real estate rental services. ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.
profiles.2124: JAC Recruitment Co., Ltd. provides recruitment consultancy services in Japan. It provides recruitment services for job positions, such as specialists and middle-level management positions. The company also offers its services under the JAC Recruitment, JAC Digital, JAC Executive, JAC International, JAC Career, JAC Interim Professional Solutions, JAC RPO, and CareerCross brands. The company was formerly known as JAC Japan Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JAC Recruitment Co., Ltd. in April 2009. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.9416: Vision Inc., together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in the provision of mobile Wi-Fi router rental services in Japan and internationally. It also offers information infrastructure and office devices, such as fixed communication and mobile communication devices, OA equipment, business phones, and website creation; and travel information and transportation services. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
profiles.4674: Cresco Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of information technology (IT) services and digital solutions in Japan. The company operates through the IT Service Business and Digital Solution Business segments. The IT Service Business segment offers enterprise systems, financial systems, embedded systems, AI systems, mobile systems, platforms, agile development, nearshore development, offshore development, RPA implementation support, data analytics, and UX design consulting solutions, as well as comprehensive IT planning, development, and maintenance services. The Digital Solution Business segment is involved in cloud computing, robotics, AI and data, security, and UX/UI. The IT services business segment is involved in the planning, development, and maintenance services, including consulting on enterprise systems, financial systems, embedded systems, AI systems, mobile systems, platforms, agile development, nearshore development, offshore development, RPA implementation support, data analytics, and UX design. It serves information, communications, advertising, distribution services, transportation, recruitment and staffing, public sector, resources and energy, construction and real estate, travel and hotels, medical and healthcare, banking, insurance, other, automobiles and transportation equipment, and machinery and electronics industries. Cresco Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.5989: H-One Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive and motorcycle parts, and dies and welding equipment in Japan, North America, Asia, and China. The company offers automobile frames, including front bulkhead, front side frame, rear frame, rear wheelhouse comp, and pillar comp, as well as door beams. It also provides motorcycle and power products, such as control levers, yoke rotors, and pushrods; and metal separators and 3DQ body frames, as well as dies and welding equipment. The company was formerly known as Hirata Technical Co., Ltd., and changed its name to H-One Co.,Ltd. in April 2006. H-One Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.
profiles.2935: Pickles Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells pickled vegetables and side dishes in Japan. It also engages in the restaurant and retail business; agricultural business; and the development and export of sweet potato products. Pickles Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Tokorozawa, Japan.
profiles.5659: Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel wires in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It offers stainless-steel wires, such as spring, micro, cold heading, shaft, weaving, and high alloy/titanium wires for use in vehicles, aircraft, office automation appliances, electric appliances, medical instruments, commodities, and leisure goods, as well as screws, steel nettings, etc. The company also offers filament yarn, cloth, tape, belt, felt, knit, sleeve, chop, and other metal fibers under the NASLON brand name. In addition, it provides filters, such as metal filters, including NASLON filters, NPM filters, EXCEL PORE, FINE MET, and re-washable systems for synthetic fiber, film, resin, nuclear and thermal power generation, petroleum refining, medical, and other applications; and semiconductor gas filters for process and bulk gases, component protection, integrated gas panels, and diffusers. Further, the company offers palladium alloy roll-plated hydrogen separation membrane for high purity hydrogen gas production and purification; high-strength copper-alloy wire for optical pickup and camera module; stainless steel wire for high corrosion resistant and heat resistant springs; hydrogen embrittlement resistant stainless steel spring wire; duplex stainless-steel wire for corrosion resistant springs, ropes, fasteners, wire mesh, etc.; and co-based alloy for medical use. The company was formerly known as The Sanshin Special Wire Manufacturing Company and changed its name to Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. in October 1956. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Daido Steel Co., Ltd.
profiles.6999: KOA Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells circuit components in Japan, Asia, America, and Europe. The company offers SMD and leaded resistors, low resistance/current sense shunt resistors, thermistors, thermal sensors, fuses, varistors, LTCC substrates, hybrid ICs, check terminals, inductors, jumper wires, resistors for space use, and other electronic parts and components. Its products are used in automotive, industrial equipment, ecology and energy saving, telecommunication, AV/home appliance, power supply unit, space/satellite, and medical equipment applications. KOA Corporation was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Kamiina, Japan.
profiles.8084: Ryoden Corporation sells factory automation (FA) systems, cooling and heating systems, information and communication technologies (ICT), building systems, smart agriculture, healthcare, system integration, and electronics businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through FA Systems Business, Refrigeration and Cooling Building Systems Business, X-Tech Business, and Electronics Business segments. The FA Systems Business segment offers servo systems, inverters, and NC devices. The Refrigeration and cooling building systems business segment provides packaged air conditioners, chilling units, freezers, and elevators. The X-Tech Business segment offers video and image information systems, medical facilities, and plant factory systems. The Electronics business segment provides memory, microcontrollers, power devices, materials, and raw materials. In addition, it provides smart pest management, consumer and industrial devices, automotive devices, security, RFID, IT equipment, and smart agriculture products; as well as industrial systems, HVAC cooling and heating, building, energy management, and hospital solutions. The company was formerly known as Ryoden Trading Company, Limited and changed its name to Ryoden Corporation in June 2016. Ryoden Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.7721: TOKYO KEIKI INC., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells marine and port, hydraulic and pneumatic, fluid, defence and communication, inspection, and railway equipment in Japan, Europe, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers marine systems, including gyrocompass, fibre optic gyrocompass, autopilot systems, ECDIS, speed log, magnetic compass, straight leg course control unit, digital course recorder, and bridge navigation watch alarm system; fluid power systems, such as direct drive system, vane pumps, piston pumps, vane motors, COMNICA valve, digital valve, manifold block, power package, and switches and sensors. It also provides ultrasonic flowmeter, radar level gauge, other products, and partner company items; avionic systems and equipment, naval systems and equipment, and other products; maritime traffic products; vibrating silicon-gyro attitude sensor VSAS-T1G and VSAS-4GM, velocity type strong motion seismometer TSM-1, and for vibration isolation seismometer application servo accelerometer TA-25J; and fibre optic gyrocompass for tunnel. In addition, the company offers solid state power oscillator; web inspection system; and ultrasonic rail inspection car, ultrasonic rail flaw detector, portable ultrasonic rail flaw imager, switch profile gauge, expansion gap gauge, and data depot system. The company was formerly known as Tokimec Inc. and changed its name to TOKYO KEIKI INC. in 2008. TOKYO KEIKI INC. was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.3762: TechMatrix Corporation engages in the information infrastructure and application service business in Japan. The company provides security products, such as for next-generation endpoint protection and next-generation firewalls, SASE and ZTNA authentication, and EDR, XDR, and SOAR solutions. It also provides security solutions, network/storage, medical image management system, business intelligence solutions, digital communication, and market-based business management systems for financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Nichimen Data Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TechMatrix Corporation in November 2000. TechMatrix Corporation was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.4662: Focus Systems Corporation provides IT services for public and private clients in Japan. The company also engages in the service of information security products; investment, development, and acting as intermediaries for companies and venture businesses; consulting and contract computer system development; systems operation and maintenance; development and distribution of information security technology and associated products, as well as software packages; planning and production of web content; temp staffing services; and other computer-related services. In addition, it is involved in the provision of technical support services for the realization of social infrastructure systems, such as my number-related, financial, trade, air traffic control, automobile-related, and insurance and pension systems; development of communication control systems, software for information and communication devices, and embedded software; infrastructure design and construction, mainframe operations, and related services; and IoT and information products and solutions. Further, the company provides core systems, computerization/efficiency, IT infrastructure, cloud/virtualization, security, and built-in technologies; and cryptography, digital watermark, beacon/directional receivers, and workflow/electronic contracts. It serves communication, finance, social security, aviation, automobile/transportation, trade/transportation, electronic administration, and local government fields. Focus Systems Corporation was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
profiles.5970: G-Tekt Corporation manufactures and sells auto body components and transmission parts in Japan and internationally. It provides auto body components, such as dashboards, side structures, rear seat reinforcement components, frames, and floor components; vehicle transmission parts; and dies and production systems. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.
profiles.1899: Fukuda Corporation operates in the construction and real estate business. It engages in the contracting, planning, design, supervision, and consulting of construction works; buying and selling, exchange, rental, and management of real estate properties; construction and sale of houses and pavements; and sale of land. It also offers regional and urban development, and environmental improvement services, as well as related contracting, planning, design, supervising, and consulting services. In addition, it is involved in the ownership, lease, and management of accommodation, sports, recreation, health and medical facilities, etc. Further, it processes, sells, and rents construction materials, equipment, and machinery. Additionally, it engages in civil engineering technology comprising tunnels, dams, bridges, roads, and waterways; and architectural technology, including disaster preparedness, quality improvement, shorter construction periods, labor savings, and environmental considerations. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.
profiles.5423: Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various steel products in Japan, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers steel building materials, such as H-beams, high-standard electric furnace H-beam, fine sized H-beam (tuned-H), striped H-beams, grooved steel, I-beams, U-shape sheet pile, deformed bars, and cold rolled square steel pipes. It also provides steel plate products, including hot coils, pickling coils, hot-dip galvanized coils, striped coils, cut sheets, and high-standard electric arc furnace steel sheets. Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.3148: Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the drug store, prescription drug store, nursing care, and related businesses in Japan. The company sells medical and health products, medical devices, health foods, cosmetics, baby products, daily necessities, pet supplies, food products, and other items; and operates paid assisted living facilities and related businesses. It is also involved in operation of SALONDAY, a rehabilitation-type adult day care service; CREATE SD Nursing Care Support Center, a home care support service; sells food and daily necessities; operates supermarkets/real estate leasing; cleaning and landscaping services for stores and other facilities; sales support services for stores; clerical support and related operations; and plans and develops private brand products. Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
profiles.7388: FP Partner Inc. engages in the insurance agency business in Japan. The company offers life insurance and non-life insurance products; investment trusts and bonds and other related financial products; financial planning services related to financial products; and marketing and consulting services. It also provides in-person consultations through home visits and at money doctor branches and in-branch consultation booths. FP Partner Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.
profiles.9729: TOKAI Corp. provides various healthy life services in Japan. It operates through Health and Life Services, Pharmacy Services, and Environmental Services segments. The company engages in hospital-related business that includes rental of hospital bedding and white coats, linen supply, nursing assistance, and in-hospital logistics management. It is also involved in the rental and sale of nursing care products and home renovation services under the nursing care insurance system; operation of MIC Health Forest day service facility for the rehabilitation for the elderly; development and manufacture finishing process machinery and equipment for dry cleaning factories; provision of meal services comprising regular and therapeutic meals; and water delivery business under the Aqua Clara brand. In addition, the company engages in the operation of Tanpopo Pharmacy specialty dispensing pharmacy and Drugmic drugstore chain; rental of environmental beautification products under the Leaskin brand; cleaning and management of hospital and other buildings; and solar business. Further, it is involved in the production of business reports, individual surveys, brochure creation, and booklets, as well as the operation of business information. Additionally, it serves medical institutions and nursing care facilities. TOKAI Corp. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.
profiles.1964: Chugai Ro Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the heat treatment business in Japan, China, Asia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Heat Treatment Furnace, Plant, and Development. The company offers parts and materials heat treatment furnace; steel and non-ferrous metal plants; burners and steelmaking-related inflame treating equipment; coating and drying equipment; air pollution control system; kiln and environmental process equipment; processing equipment for materials; contract testing; and maintenance, energy conservation, and improvement support. It is also involved in the design, manufacturing, installation, and sale of various industrial furnaces; technical guidance, operation, and maintenance of facilities; temporary staffing; procurement of materials and combustion equipment; and technical services. The company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
profiles.8616: Tokai Tokyo Financial Holdings, Inc. operates as a securities company in Japan. The company offers foreign and domestic equities; foreign, municipal, and structured bonds; derivatives; investment trust services; forex; and investment banking services, such as IPOs, public stock offerings, secondary sales, and mergers and acquisitions. It is also involved in the financial instruments business; research on economic conditions and corporate performance; creation and management of funds, and self-financed and fund investments; consulting on handling of testamentary trusts and inheritance property; asset management; education and training; provision of transfer agency, merchandising, printing, real estate rental management, and insurance agency services; and outsourced back-office operations. In addition, the company offers information, investment and securities management, advisory, and agency services. The company was formerly known as Tokai Tokyo Securities Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tokai Tokyo Financial Holdings, Inc. in April 2009. Tokai Tokyo Financial Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1929 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.6258: Hirata Corporation manufactures and sells various manufacturing line systems, industrial robots, and logistic equipment in Japan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Automotive-Related; Semiconductor-Related; and Other Automated Labor-Saving Equipment. The company offers automotive related production equipment, such as electric vehicle related equipment, including electric drive units (EDU), gear box for EDU, rotors, stators, inverters, IGBT, battery modules, battery packs, and LIB charge discharged, as well as coating and drying; engine assembly, cylinder head assembly, and piston assembly lines; transmission related equipment comprising CVT assembly, automatic transmission assembly, and DCT assembly lines; and engine and component related equipment. It also provides semiconductor related equipment, including equipment front end modules/sorters, wafer transfer robots, aligners, load ports, and SMIF openers; and panel manufacturing systems, such as coater systems, glass cutting systems, coating and lamination systems, and auto-loader systems. In addition, the company offers industrial robot equipment comprising cartesian, SCARA-type, articulated, and substrate transfer robots, as well as 3D vision systems, robot controllers, teach pendants, and robot simulators; electronics and electrical appliance production equipment that includes home electronics related automated assembly lines, and electronic components and others; and power modules consisting of mounters, vacuum reflow ovens, and ultrasonic welders. Further, it provides sorting/stocking systems, stacker cranes, and traceability systems for production management; and medical/chemistry and physics devices, such as pathological tissue specimen preparation devices and cell destructive equipment, as well as ecoelectric series. Hirata Corporation was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Kumamoto, Japan.
profiles.6464: Tsubaki Nakashima Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial precision balls, rollers, blowers, and medical equipment and hygiene equipment in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Precision Components Business and Bloor Real Estate Business segments. It offers precision steel balls, including bearing and stainless steel, ballpoint pen, and various metal balls for use in home electronics, such as air conditioners, refrigerators, and vacuum cleaners; and precision tapered, spherical, cylindrical, and needle rollers. The company also provides precision ceramic balls, including silicon nitride and alumina oxide balls for use in wind power generators, electric vehicles, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment applications. In addition, it offers medical and metrology products. Further, the company provides iron and steel, electric power, wind tunnel, and other blowers for steel, thermal power, nuclear power, biomass power, and other applications; and customized solutions comprising solid plastic balls, specially manufactured products, and glass balls for medical diagnostic tests and devices. Additionally, it is involved in real estate leasing. Tsubaki Nakashima Co., Ltd. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
profiles.7717: V Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and service of equipment for flat panel displays (FPDs) and semiconductors in Japan. The company offers manufacturing and inspection equipment for the inspection, repair, and measurement of FPDs. It also provides photomask equipment; and parts and materials for manufacturing FPDs, as well as product maintenance and inspection service and maintenance parts, and offers equipment upgrade services. In addition, the company is involved in the semiconductor equipment business. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
profiles.7347: Mercuria Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the fund management business in Japan, China, the Cayman Islands, and internationally. The company offers investment advisory and management, financial instrument, and asset management services. It also provides advisory and support services for the transaction, leasing, management of real estate, infrastructure facilities, machinery and equipment, and standing timber; and consulting services. In addition, the company manages and operates the Spring real estate investment trust; operates Bizma, a matching site provider for SMEs; and various financial services. Mercuria Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.1786: Oriental Shiraishi Corporation produces, constructs, and sells prestressed concrete products and structures in Japan. It operates through three segments: Construction Business, Steel Structure Business, and Port Business. The Construction business segment engages in construction work and manufacturing/sales of prestressed concrete civil engineering structures, pneumatic caissons; repair and reinforcement work for bridges, prestressed concrete building structures; and design and construction, design and production of construction equipment, civil engineering contracting, and rental of construction machinery. The Steel Structure Business segment involved in the design, manufacturing, erection, repair and reinforcement of steel structures such as bridges. The Port business segment operates port, civil engineering, and construction work. It also engages in the design and construction of earthquake-resistant buildings; rents real estate, and the sale of construction materials and devices. In addition, the company generates, supplies, and sells solar power through the operation and administration of solar power plants. Oriental Shiraishi Corporation was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.6413: Riso Kagaku Corporation operates in printing equipment, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Printing Equipment Related Business and Real Estate Business. The company offers production printers, full-color inkjet printers, digital duplicators, and digital screen makers, as well as inkjet print engine under the VALEZUS, ComColor, GOCCOPRO, and RISOGRAPH names. It also engages in the leasing of buildings; the print creation and digital communication business; and the application software business. It offers its products to educational institutions, government and public agencies, companies, and local communities. Riso Kagaku Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.4212: Sekisui Jushi Corporation provides various products and services through the application of composite technology in Japan. The company offers soundproofing materials; traffic safety products; electronic system-related products; road marking materials; road signs; and pedestrian and vehicle guardrails, snow and windbreak fences, wheel stops, prefabricated walkways, railings, park materials, shelters, solar lighting, artificial wood, etc. It also provides artificial turf, artificial turf field watering system, artificial turf field high-speed drainage system, temporary traffic safety products, heat-shielding pavement, concrete spalling prevention systems, signs, billboards, etc. In addition, the company offers mesh and vertical lattice fence, privacy and soundproof privacy walls, bicycle parking areas, and handrail products; packaging and binding bands and films, packaging materials, packaging machinery, safety fences, RFID-related products, agricultural materials, greenhouse horticultural materials, wildlife damage control products, aluminum-resin laminated composite panels, decorative building materials, assembly pipe systems, digital picking systems, automotive parts and related products, etc. Sekisui Jushi Corporation was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.
profiles.6151: Nitto Kohki Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells couplings, machine tools, pumps, and door closers in Japan, America, Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania. It operates in four segments: Quick Connect Couplings Business; Power & Machine Tools Business; Pumps & Compressors Business; and Door Closers Business. The company offers quick connect couplings under the CUPLA brand, including HHV, compact zerospill, full blow, hygienic, mutli, semicon, hi, and micro for various air, water, oil, and chemical solutions; power and machine tools, such as atra ace, selfer, beveler, and jet broach and chisel for boring, cutting, grinding, and scaling of steel materials. It also provides electric screw-driver under the delvo brand. Nitto Kohki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.
profiles.3580: KOMATSU MATERE Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, development, manufacturing, and sale of synthetic fabrics and thin film fabrics in Japan, Europe, the Middle East, East and Southeast Asia, North America, and internationally. It is involved in the manufacture and sale of fabrics for various apparel, including fashion clothing, sportswear, and uniforms, as well as for a range of applications comprising interiors, automotive interior materials, medical and welfare equipment, and electrical materials; and plans, proposes, manufactures, and sells products in the fields of fashion clothing and sportswear. profiles.7384: Procrea Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company for the Aomori Michinoku Bank, Ltd. that provides banking products and services in Japan. The company’s financial services include deposits, lending, trading of commodity securities, securities investment, and foreign exchange, as well as corporate bond underwriting and registration services, and related services. It also offers credit cards, credit guarantees, and debt management and collection businesses; and consulting, leasing, and real estate management and leasing services. In addition, the company engages in leasing of machinery, fixtures, and equipment. Procrea Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Aomori, Japan.
profiles.3778: SAKURA Internet Inc. provides cloud computing services in Japan. The company operates data centers. It also engages in the development of software for telecommunications; operation of telecommunication systems and consulting for telecommunications carriers; security consulting and vulnerability assessment; planning, production and sales of multimedia; planning, management, operation, and sale of rental servers (VPS); analysis and distribution of disaster and weather information; information services provision through the internet; planning, production, and sales of multimedia; web design, development, design, management, planning, operation and sale; internet services business; service integration business; consulting business; virtual offices and shared offices business; system integration; leasing, maintenance, and management of telecommunication facilities; and development, sales, rental, maintenance, and management of computer hardware and software products. SAKURA Internet Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
profiles.6080: M&A Capital Partners Co.,Ltd. engages in the mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage business in Japan. It offers mediation, brokerage, advisory, database provision, and media management services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.4547: Kissei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products primarily in Japan and internationally. It offers Calogra tablets, for the treatment of ulcerative colitis; Tabneos capsules for the treatment of microscopic polyangiitis and granulomatous polyangiitis; Corsuba Intravenous Dialysis Syringe for the treatment of chronic idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura; Beova tablets for the treatment of overactive bladder treatment; and Darbepoetin Alfa BS injection JCR for the treatment of renal anemia. Its products in pipeline include CG0070, which is in Phase III clinical trial to treat non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer; Linzagolix, that is in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of uterine fibroids and endometriosis; KDT-3594, which is in Phase II clinical trial to treat Parkinson's disease; KSP-0914 that is in Phase I clinical trial to treat Graves' disease; KPS-0373, that is in Phase III clinical trial to treat Spinocerebellar degeneration; KSP- 0576 that is in Phase I clinical trial to treat interstitial cystitis and bladder pain syndrome; and KSP-0930, which is in Phase I clinical trial to treat Narcolepsy. It also develops Silodosin for dysuria associated with benign prostatic hyperplasia; and Fostamatinib for tyrosine kinase inhibitor. In addition, it develops and sells protein controlled and energy supply food; purchases and sells related materials; and offers system development and information processing, facility and equipment management, and information gathering and development support services. Further, it engages in information equipment rentals; insurance agency business; manufactures and sells noodles; construction contracting; and computer system design and development, and cloud services. The company was formerly known as Kissei Yakuhin Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kissei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in October 1964. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Matsumoto, Japan.
profiles.6653: Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. operates in the field of power system, and environmental energy and control system in Japan. It offers power system business unit, environmental energy control business unit, environmental energy and control systems business unit, power electronics unit, IT system solution business unit, electronic control devices unit, liquid crystal film for optical shutter, and service and engineering business unit. The company also offers power receiving, transforming, and monitoring/control systems for water and sewage facilities, lighting control systems for expressways, energy storage systems, battery power conditioners, and solutions for renewable energy and AI data centers; cloud services (SaaS) for ports, healthcare, and e-learning, as well as business support systems utilizing artificial intelligence and IoT; sales of digitalization and decarbonization products, including electrical machinery, energy-saving equipment, and robots, along with engineering, construction, and maintenance services; and control equipment, electronic devices, light control films, electrical work, and machinery installation services. The company serves central and various government offices; electric, gas, and environmental plant companies; automobile, ship building, iron, steel, nonferrous metal, electrical machinery plants; science, chemical, food products, and paper manufacturing companies; and construction companies. The company was formerly known as Seiko Shokai and changed its name to Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. in 1960. Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.
profiles.9119: Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the shipping and real estate businesses in Japan, Saudi Arabia, and internationally. The company operates through: Overseas Shipping, Domestic and Coastal Shipping, and Real Estate Business segments. The company operates oil tankers, including very large crude carriers(VLCCs) for the transport of crude oil and petroleum products; chemical tankers to transport liquid cargoes, such as petrochemical products, methanol, sulfuric acid, vegetable oil, ethanol, and lubricating oils; fleet of large and domestic gas carriers that transport liquefied gases comprising liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and liquefied natural gas(LNG); medium and small gas carriers to transport LPG, vinyl chloride monomer(VCM), propylene; and dry bulk carriers to transport coal for electric power generation, coking coal, grains, wood chips for paper production, fertilizers, wood biomass fuel, and construction materials. It also offers real estate service; hall and conference center management; event space; and shipping agency services. In addition, the company provides photography studios and support for advertisers and magazine publishers. Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.8708: Aizawa Securities Group Co., Ltd. operates financial securities business in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Financial instrument securities business, Asset management business, and Investment business. It also engages in the financial product intermediation business. Aizawa Securities Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.9267: Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd. engages in the management and operation of food and drug chain stores in Japan. The company retails pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, miscellaneous goods, food, and other products. It also engages in food manufacturing, store development, and logistics business. Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.
profiles.8860: Fuji Corporation Limited designs, constructs, and sells detached houses and condominiums in Japan. The company operates through five segments: Real Estate Business, Land Utilization Business, Leasing and Management Business, Construction-related Business, and Other Businesses. It also engages in the housing distribution activities; and contract construction and sales of rental apartment buildings. In addition, the company is involved in real estate management, brokerage, and renovation activities. Fuji Corporation was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Kishiwada, Japan.
profiles.7296: F.C.C. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells clutches for automobiles, motorcycles, and general-purpose machinery in Japan and internationally. It offers clutches, such as wet-type multi-disc, wet-type multi-disc assisted and slipper, wet-type and dry centrifugal, and racing clutches, as well as pulleys for belt converters for motorcycles, road sports bikes, scooters, ATVs, and racing vehicles. The company provides automobiles clutches, including automatic transmission, HEV, torque converter lockup, manual transmission, and 4WD vehicle clutches. In addition, it offers general-purpose clutches, such as FCCTRAC, a cam-type torque-sensitive limited slip differential for four wheel ATVs, and hydraulic static transmissions for snow throwers and lawn mowers. The company was formerly known as Fuji Chemical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to F.C.C. Co., Ltd. in July 1984. F.C.C. Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.
profiles.8163: SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of Japanese food restaurant in Japan. It operates restaurants under the Washoku Sato, Tendon & Tempura Honpo Santen, Nigiri CHOJIRO, Miyamoto Munashi, Katsuya, Kazokutei, Umaihirekan, Tokutoku, Himawari, Torisho, Gyuno Fuku, and Karayama brand names, as well as operates a Japanese traditional café under the Meotozenzai name. The company was formerly known as Sato Restaurant Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2017. SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
profiles.6254: Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. engages in the design, construction, and sale of water production equipment in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers water treatment plants and equipment, including pure and ultra-pure water systems, pharmaceutical water production systems, wastewater treatment systems, and water reclamation systems. It also provides pretreatment systems, heat regenerative type membrane filtration equipment, coagulating sedimentation equipment, flocculation filtration, gravity filtration, and pressure filtration equipment, electrodeionization, ion exchange systems, reverse osmosis (RO) systems, vacuum and membrane degasifier, pure steam generators, package type purified water production systems, WFI production systems, ozone and hydrogen water production systems, and anti-static equipment. In addition, the company offers return contamination monitor, endotoxin monitor, H2O2 monitor, nuclepore membrane, filter cartridge, and piping and environmental materials; and site supply of pure water, and water analysis and evaluation services on a contract basis. It serves electronics, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, food, environmental energy, and analysis industries. Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Atsugi, Japan.
profiles.2217: Morozoff Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells confectionery products in Japan. It operates through Confectionery Manufacturing and Sales; and Cafe and Restaurant Management divisions. The company offers chocolates, cookies, cheesecakes, puddings and jellies, cakes, summer desserts, baked goods, frozen sweets, and summer gift sets. It also operates coffee shops. The company sells its products through directly managed stores, mall stores, station building stores, department stores, and its online shop. The company was formerly known as Morozoff Seika Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Morozoff Limited in August 1972. Morozoff Limited was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
profiles.1968: Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the plant construction business in Japan and internationally. The company constructs and maintains clean energy, steelmaking, petrochemicals, cement, waste disposal, recycling facilities, and theme parks, as well as thermal, nuclear, and geothermal power stations; and renewable energy power generation, such as biomass, geothermal and solar, and fuel cell power plants. It is also involved in mechanical design, electrical and instrumentation design, work planning, technical development, civil and construction design, and field engineering; maintenance and major overhaul works and decommissioning works; and petrochemical plants, steel manufacturing, and paper manufacturing. In addition, the company provides equipment installation services for building facilities, amusement facilities; operation and maintenance services; and education and training programs. Further, it is involved in the construction and maintenance of gas-turbine, diesel engine, combined cycle and wind power plants; design and production of steel mill, sugar refining, cement and other industrial plants; refuse incineration, dioxin treatment, sludge treatment and waste recycling plants; design, manufacture, installation and maintenance of various electrical system, sub-station, control system, optical fiber communication system, building electrical facilities; design and construction of heat ventilation and air conditioning system, and utility sanitary system; and design, procurement and fabrication of machined products, tanks, piping, class-2 pressure vessels, electrical and control panels. Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.3543: KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd. operates a coffee shop franchise business under the Komeda Coffee and Okagean brand names in Japan. It also involved in the real estate leasing activities. KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
profiles.6741: Nippon Signal Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops technologies for railway signal systems in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Transportation Infrastructure Business and ICT Solution Business segments. It offers railway signal safety systems, road traffic safety systems, station service automation systems, security solutions, parking lot system, robotics, platform safety systems, ground penetrating radars, and 3D laser ranging image sensors and MEMS scanners. The company is also involved in manufacture, sale, and maintenance of railway signaling equipment and road traffic safety systems; and manufacturing, sale, and maintenance services of automatic flood control equipment and parking equipment. Nippon Signal Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.7917: ZACROS Corporation manufactures and sells products for wellness environmental solutions, information electronic, and industrial infrastructure in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Wellness Business; Environmental Solutions Business; Information and Electronics Business; and Industrial Infrastructure Business. The company offers wellness products, including MediTect IV Bag, a non-adsorbing, low-leaching packaging for ready-to-use (RTU) drugs; BioPhas, a customized service that is used in single-use products for biopharmaceuticals manufacturing; and Total Thrombus-formation Analysis System, a flow chamber system. It also provides environmental solutions, such as flexible refill pouches; liquid containers; and high performance / high clean packaging. In addition, the company offers protective films; coating commissioned processing services; and free standing electrode, as well as adhesive films, release liners, tab seal film, and industrial laminate film. Further, it engages in industrial infrastructure activities. The company was formerly known as Fujimori Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ZACROS Corporation in October 2024. ZACROS Corporation was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.
profiles.4792: YAMADA Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. provides various consulting services in Japan, rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers sustainable growth, business revitalization, mergers and acquisitions, business succession, overseas business, organization personnel, corporate governance, information technology (IT) strategy and DX and AI strategies formulation, and real estate services. It also provides investment services related to unlisted stocks and real estate. The company was formerly known as TFP Consulting Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to YAMADA Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. in December 2010. YAMADA Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.2353: NIPPON PARKING DEVELOPMENT Co.,Ltd. provides consulting services for parking lot in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the car sharing and parking management operation activities; renting of parking and cars; ski resort information and operation consulting activities; management of health-related facilities; and management of and consultation services for theme parks and amusement parks. It also provides educational services; consulting services for healthy operation and wellness management, as well as related to decarbonization, power sales, and business; and medical checks and health management services. In addition, the company engages in the distribution of medical devices to medical institutions; and development, renting, subleasing, and management of residential and commercial facilities for housing and lodging purposes. Further, the company offers educational and healthcare services. NIPPON PARKING DEVELOPMENT Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
profiles.6740: Japan Display Inc. develops, designs, manufactures, and sells displays and related products in Japan and internationally. It also involved in planning, research, development, design, manufacture, sales, maintenance, rental, leasing, and providing related solution services of electrical equipment, electronic devices, and software; and provision of solutions and services related to medical devices. In addition, the company offers information collection and analysis services, as well as biometric information measurement using electronic technology. Its displays are used in medical, industries, and digital cameras. Japan Display Inc. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
profiles.6310: Iseki & Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of agricultural machinery in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It offers cultivating machineries, including tractors, tillers, high clearance multipurpose vehicles, and mowers; planting machinery, such as rice and vegetable transplanters; and harvesting machinery comprising combine harvesters and binders. The company also provides processing machinery, such as rice hullers, dryers, rice cleaners, rice graders, vegetable harvesting, and processing machinery; and implements, spare parts, agricultural facilities, as well as diesel engine. Iseki & Co., Ltd. was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Arakawa, Japan.
profiles.7628: Ohashi Technica Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells automotive parts and other components in Japan, the United States, China, Thailand, ASEAN, Europe, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers automotive parts comprising engine and mission, differential, brake, body and chasse, and interior/exterior components; and information technology (IT) and communications device parts, including mobile phone hinges and other IT and communications parts. It also provides precision oil pump shafts used in dual clutch transmission; and piezo injector components for diesel engines. In addition, the company plans, develops, produces, and markets precision components assembled to various products in automobile and other industries, as well as engages in procurement, export, and logistics businesses. It serves auto and auto part unit equipment manufacturers. The company was formerly known as Ohashi Shoji, Inc. and changed its name to Ohashi Technica Inc. in May 1987. Ohashi Technica Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.7278: EXEDY Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and sale of manual transmissions, automatic transmissions, and drive transmissions for automobiles in Japan, America, Asia, Oceania, and internationally. It offers torque converters and AT Parts; clutch covers and disks for passenger vehicles, trucks, and buses, as well as clutch discs for motorsports; power shift transmission, retarder, and damper disc for construction machinery; power shift transmission for industrial vehicles; and dual clutch for agricultural machinery; and AT and MT motorcycle clutches. The company was formerly known as Daikin Manufacturing Co., Ltd and changed its name to EXEDY Corporation in 1995. EXEDY Corporation was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Neyagawa, Japan.
profiles.3903: gumi Inc. provides mobile online games in Japan and internationally. It operates in Neo Media Entertainment Business and Neo Crypto Business. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.6652: IDEC Corporation engages in the human-machine interface (HMI), industrial relays and components, automation and sensing, safety and explosion protection, and systems businesses in Japan, America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers HMI products comprising control switches, joysticks, indicator lights and buzzers, and programmable displays; industrial relays and components consisting of switching power supplies, terminal blocks, control relays and sockets, circuit protectors, relay socket timers, and LED lighting products. It also provides automation and sensing products, such as programmable controllers, automatic identification and recognition devices, software, ethernet devices, sensors, and ionizers; and motorized systems, including safety and assisted wheel drives. In addition, the company provides safety and explosion protection products comprising emergency stop pushbutton switches, safety switches, and enabling and explosion-protection devices; collaborative robot system solutions; and mega-solar and photovoltaic power generation power management systems. Further, the company serves AGVs/AMRs, car, robotics, automotive, material handling, agricultural and construction machinery, machine tools, semiconductors, and food and packaging industries. The company was formerly known as Izumi Denki Corporation. IDEC Corporation was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
profiles.2884: Yoshimura Food Holdings K.K., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells food products in Japan, Singapore, and Malaysia. It operates through Manufacturing Business, Sales Business, and Other Businesses segments. The company offers peanut butter creamy, chocolate creamy, Chinese cuisine ingredients, spring roll wrappers, wine, dried bonito shavings, dashi, soup, nabe sets, sushi, rolls, rice balls, soft furikake, jellies, seaweed, hijiki, mekabu, ramen noodles, gyoza dumpling skins, sauces, scallops, salmon, salmon roe, crab, sweet fish, processed seafood products, chestnuts, Chinese entrées, sake, dry noodles, buckwheat and wheat flour, pork cutlets, and tuna. It also provides frozen food, such as seafood products, fried oysters, fried chicken cartilage, and fried chicken tender cutlets, as well as freeze-dried products. In addition, the company imports, sells, and maintains commercial kitchen equipment; and trades in healthy food. Further, it engages in the operation of hot spring facilities and restaurants; real estate leasing and management; and event, media, and marketing business activities. Yoshimura Food Holdings K.K. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.4053: Sun* Inc. engages in the digital creative studio business in Japan. The company offers creative and engineering services, including support for business design, prototype development, full development, and growth. It also provides talent platform services to support new business development and digital transformation. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.8070: Tokyo Sangyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells machinery, plant facilities, materials, tools, and chemicals in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Electric Power Business; Environment, Chemicals, and Machinery Business; and Lifestyle Industry Business segments. It installs power generation equipment, such as thermal and nuclear power plant peripheral equipment, power transmission and transformation equipment, etc., and provides maintenance and after-the-sale services of existing equipment for electric power companies. The company also sells and provides installation support for machinery used in chemical plants and renewable energy, as well as machine tools for chemical, petroleum refining, pharmaceutical, textile, rubber, and non-ferrous metal industries. In addition, it is involved in the marine and fishery businesses; and lifestyle related businesses, including water-saving automatic flushing devices, shopping bags, fashion bags, garbage bags, packaging materials, etc. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Kenzai Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tokyo Sangyo Co., Ltd. in July 1947. Tokyo Sangyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.2168: Pasona Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of human resources consulting, recruitment, temporary staffing, education, training, and contracting and outsourcing services in Japan. The company offers HR and BPO solutions, such as expert services, recruitment, and career support services; business process outsourcing; DX promotion services; management and HR consulting; public solutions; reskilling and business training/next generation leader training; and health management promotion support services. It also provides childcare support; early childhood and child education/human resource development; nursing care facility management; support for balancing work and caregiving; and housekeeping services. In addition, the company offers staffing, recruitment agency, executive search, and job expo; expatriate payroll, establishment of salary regulations, and global personnel system/evaluation system/work regulations; support for expanding overseas bases and business improvement proposals; and mental health care, health management support, and employee benefit services. Further, it is involved in regional revitalization; tourism and sightseeing; restaurant and cafe; wellness retreat; agriculture; arts and culture/entertainment; and educational community businesses. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.2492: Infomart Corporation operates a business-to-business (BtoB) electronic commerce platform in Japan. The company operates in BtoB-PF FOOD business and BtoB-PFES business segments. The company offers BtoB Platform Invoices that digitalize both invoice receipt and issuance.; BtoB Platform Ordering for digitize everything from order placement to invoicing; BtoB platform TRADE to manage quotation, ordering, receiving, delivery, inspection, and invoicing operations digitally; BtoB Platform Ordering Lite for managing Order information from faxes, telephone calls, emails, and on the cloud; BtoB Platform Contract, a secure electronic contract service; TANOMU, a wholesale ordering system; and BP Storage for digitizing everything from invoice receipt and issuance, expense reimbursement, document storage, and carbon dioxide emission measurement. It also provides BtoB Platform Negotiations for Matching sellers, food wholesalers, restaurants, and other businesses with buyers; V-Manage to digitally manage store operations and management task; AI-OCR (invox), an AI OCR processes and digitizes faxes, emails, and PDF purchase orders; BP Workflow to digitizing internal approval and application procedures; electronic bill early payment that convert pending invoices into cash; BtoB Platform Quotation which centralized and digitized receipt and quotation; BtoB platform industry channel, an industry information portal site that streamlines sales and planning operations; Menu Plus, digitize your restaurant's menu management; Kauri Kessai, streamline processes, such as credit checks for business partners, payment collection, and payment reconciliation; BtoB platform order placement; and BtoB eSmart, a commercial food ingredients, supplies, and materials site. Infomart Corporation was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.5357: Yotai Refractories Co., Ltd., manufactures and sells refractories and ceramics in Japan and internationally. It operates through Refractories and Engineering segments. The company offers fireproof bricks from various materials, including alkaline, high alumina-made, clay-made, and silica bricks; ceramic and environmental system-related furnaces; and monolithic refractories for the steel, non-ferrous, cement, glass, environmental equipment, electronic parts, and chemical and pottery industries. It also provides engineering services, which comprises design, construction, and supervisory services; designs and constructs linings for industrial furnaces, as well as contract maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Osaka Yogyo Fire Brick Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yotai Refractories Co., Ltd. in June 1987. Yotai Refractories Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Kaizuka, Japan.
profiles.5707: Toho Zinc Co., Ltd. operates in the metal recycling, mineral resources, electronic components, advanced materials, and environmental and recycling businesses in Japan. The company offers electrolytic zinc, die-casting zinc alloys, zinc powder, cadmium oxide, sulfuric acid, electrolytic lead, lead alloys, and electrolytic silver and bismuth. It also operates zinc and lead mines; and produces iron, ferrite, amorphous powders, and Fe-Al-Si based powder core materials for use in automotive electronics, office automation equipment, and industrial equipment. In addition, the company provides MAIRON and ATOMIRON electrolytic irons, as well as produces recycled zinc oxide from electric furnace dust. Toho Zinc Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.4116: Dainichiseika Color & Chemicals Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells powders, pigment dispersions, and functional materials in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Color & Functional Products; Polymers & Coating Materials; and Graphics & Printing Materials. It offers inorganic, organic, and prepared pigments for applications including paints, printing inks, and information display and recording materials; mass colorants for synthetic fibers, pigment printing agents, and colorants for paper and construction materials; and colorants for thermoplastic resins. The company also provides colorants for PVC, fluoropolymer, and other resins; UV and EB curable coating agents and decorative and functional coating agents, as well as functional products for the electronics and information materials, automotive and interior construction materials fields; and urethane resins and colorants used for synthetic leather and molded products, special coating agents and adhesives. In addition, it offers Chitosan polymer and its derivatives; printing inks for paper media; and inks and peripheral products for gravure printing. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.6644: Osaki Electric Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, sells, and installs meters in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Smart Meters & Solutions in Japan, Smart Meters & Solutions Overseas, and Real Estate segments. The company offers residential and commercial metering devices, such as smart meters and gas meters; and a range of low voltage switchgear systems, including distribution boards, sub-boards, floor stand boards, motor control sensors, and power distribution units. It also provides information and communication related products consisting of optical couplers and switches, optical distributing frames, and electric power distribution panels and shelters. In addition, the company offers software, and related products and services, such as demand control equipment, head end systems, meter data management systems, and data visualization products. Further, it engages in the real estate leasing business. The company was formerly known as Kogyo Seisakujo and changed its name to Osaki Electric Co., Ltd. in April 1941. The company was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.4229: Gun Ei Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells synthetic resins and fibers in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Chemicals Business, Food Business, Real Estate Utilization Business. The company offers Resitop for photoresists, epoxy curing agent, maleimide curing agent, liquid type Resitop, and high purity bisphenol F; casting iron and aluminum casts; automobiles and construction machines; molding materials, papermaking, coated abrasive, resinoid grinding stone, carbon insulating materials, spherical carbon, air filter, oil filter, scoring pad, high-performance fiber, carbon fiber, and Kynol activated carbon fiber products; and heat insulating material Resitop for glass wool/rock wool. In addition, the company provides food, such as starches and sugars; and business outsourcing and staffing services. Further, it is involved in the leasing of real estate. Further, the company offers Milex, a phenolic resin for brake pads that improves braking through a chemical reaction based on a unique technology. Gun Ei Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Takasaki, Japan.
profiles.1882: Toa Road Corporation engages in the civil engineering business in Japan. It constructs road networks and transportation infrastructure, such as expressways and national roads, as well as paving on bridges and tunnels. The company also undertakes civil works, including airport projects and civil construction parts of the road projects, as well as super express, railway container yard, photovoltaic power generation, and regional contribution and disaster recovery projects. In addition, it manufactures and sells asphalt emulsion for roads, railways, landscape, and sports facilities; asphalt mixtures; polymer-modified asphalt for heavy traffic roads, porous asphalt pavements, bridge deck pavements, and cold regions; and pavement materials for various applications, including garages and bridges. Further, the company provides pavement materials for various landscaping locations comprising historical places and parks; and sports pavement materials for use in running tracks, baseball stadiums, tennis courts, bicycle racetracks, and others. Additionally, it conducts surveying/cleaning of soil pollution; designs and builds various underground reservoirs; demolishes buildings, factories, chimneys, etc. for redevelopment projects; and provides road maintenance plans that integrate pavement maintenance techniques comprising planning, inspection/diagnosis, performance evaluation/forecasting, maintenance/rehabilitation design, etc. with asset management. The company was incorporated in 1930 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.9948: ARCS Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in retail business and related operations in Japan. The company operates 10 community-based food supermarkets and other general retail store chains. It is also involved in home improvement, building maintenance, insurance, non-life and life insurance agency business, industrial waste and general waste collection and transportation business, resource environment, and travel businesses. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.
profiles.3915: TerraSky Co.,Ltd. provides cloud products and solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers cloud integration services comprising Salesforce, AI agent implementation support, MuleSoft Anypoint, Amazon Web services, Heroku, contact center, SAP migration, B2B commerce, and financial services cloud and marketing cloud solutions, as well as solutions for manufacturing industries. It also provides cloud consulting services comprising digital marketing support, DX promotion consulting, AppExchange consulting, marketing tool implementation support service, production support solutions, and data utilization support service; development support tools, such as mitoco X, flosum, ACCELQ, DCSpider, skyvisual editor, and Elements.cloud services; and cloud services, including mitoco ERP, mitoco, Mitoco accounting, mitoco Work, mitoco AI, Fujitsu GLOVIA OM, Soask for subscription management, CloudSign for Salesforce, Salesforce Field Service, Insurance Agency Solution for insurance agents, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, OMLINE-I, OMLINE-O, ChoiceRESERVE Reservation Integration, SVF Cloud for Salesforce, MotionBoard Cloud for Salesforce, and invoiceAgent for to digitizing paper documents. The company was formerly known as Head Solutions Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Terasakai Co.,Ltd. in February 2007.
