It also provides construction materials, including waterproof materials, heat-insulating materials/subsidiary materials, interior trim materials, internal store trim materials, flooring materials, wooden packaging materials, and residential fittings; and petroleum products, such as fuel, heavy fuel oil, lubricating oil and grease, base oil, refrigerant oils, lubricant additives, solvent oils, asphalt, process oils, slack waxes, liquid paraffins, and other products. In addition, the company sells various films and processed films, including resins, high-precision chemicals, fillers, and printing materials; general-purpose resins, engineering plastics, super engineering plastics, PVC compounds, and elastomers, as well as foam products, FRP materials, and processed plastic products. Further, it provides lithium-ion battery cathode/anode materials, electrolyte, separator, raw materials and intermediate products, energy storage battery system, other battery products and materials, anthracite coal and processed anthracite products, and limestone and processed limestone products; and general automotive parts and materials, and raw materials. Meiwa Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.6058: Vector Inc. engages in the public relations (PR) and advertising businesses in Japan, China, and internationally. The company is also involved in public relations (PR) agency and consulting, branding activities, press release distribution, investor relations support, celebrity casting, risk management, market research, event planning and operation, SNS communication, and marketing businesses. Vector Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.2918: Warabeya Nichiyo Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of food products for convenience stores in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Food Production Business; Food Materials Business; Logistics Business; and Other segments. The company offers cooked rice products, bento meal boxes, onigiri rice balls and sushi, chilled bento meal boxes, chilled and baked bread products, side dishes and noodles, and chilled Japanese sweets. It also procures, processes, and sells food ingredients; and sorts and delivers food products and ingredients. The company was formerly known as Warabeya Nichiyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Warabeya Nichiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. in September 2016. Warabeya Nichiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.7130: Yamae Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale of food products in Japan. The company offers general processed foods, frozen food, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, livestock, bento boxes, shochu, marine products, feed, housing equipment, and construction materials. It is also involved in the leasing of real estate and other related businesses, such as transportation, fuel-related business, rental car business, information processing service business, and solar power generation business. The company serves the food manufacturing industry and restaurants. Yamae Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuoka, Japan.
profiles.7976: Mitsubishi Pencil Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies writing instruments in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Writing Instruments and Writing Instrument Peripheral Products Business; and Other Business segments. It offers pencils and colored pencils, water-based ink roller balls, oil-based ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils and refill lead, felt-tip pens and markers, and office and school supplies; and the sale of adhesive tape and handicrafts. The company also provides ballpoint pen; multifunctional and customizable pen; sign pens and markers; seals and name pens; green net; and sharp; eye makeup and hair dye products; and carbon nanotubes, acoustic matching layers, electrode materials, and containers. It serves medical care, electronics, automobiles, and cosmetics industries. Mitsubishi Pencil Co., Ltd. was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.3036: ALCONIX Corporation imports, exports, and sells non-ferrous metal products in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Electronic and Advanced Materials, Aluminum and Copper, Equipment and Materials, and Metal Processing. The company is involved in the trading of electronic and advanced materials, including materials for electronic materials and components, minor metal and rare earth raw materials (ore and ingot), and battery-related parts and materials. It also engages in the manufacture of equipment and materials related to inspection and measurement of products, and materials used in testing equipment, automotive, chemical products and new materials fields; and electronic devices, plating materials for semiconductors and busbars for power distribution. In addition, the company involved in the aluminum and copper, contains base metal products and titanium roll flat materials, and base metal materials; metal processing, which include precision cutting parts used in industrial machinery, such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment, air conditioning equipment, and aircraft engines; grinding parts in fields of semiconductors, automobiles, and industrial machinery; and metal stamped parts, automobiles, batteries, and IT equipment fields. The company was formerly known as Nissho Iwai Alconix Corporation and changed its name to ALCONIX Corporation in April 2005. ALCONIX Corporation was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.2109: Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells refined sugar and functional food materials in Japan. It operates through the Sugar Business, Life Energy Business, and Real Estate Business segments. The Sugar Business manufactures and sells raw sugar, processed sugar, and sugar-related products; rock sugar, liquid sugar, brown crystal sugar, sugar stick sachets, powdered sugar, gum syrup, and soft drink concentrates; centrifugal sugar and black sugar; sweeteners and other food ingredients; and functional food. This segment also engages in the manufacture, sale, and cargo handling of product packaging materials. The Life Energy segment provides food colorings, flavorings, sugar cane extract, agar, food additives, bio-based products, nutritional care supplements, and nutritional products for patients with dysphagia, as well as life support, and home delivery lunch box services. The Real Estate Business segment is involved in the leasing of land, retail premises, and offices, as well as warehouse operations. The company was formerly known as Mitsui DM Sugar Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. in April 2025. Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.1375: Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of mushrooms and other food products under the Yukiguni brand name in Japan. Its products include Maitake Kiwami, Maitake Kiwami White, Eringi, Buna-Shimeji, Daikoku Hon-Shimeji Tamba Shimeji, and button mushrooms; mushroom meat; health foods; and Maitake and Eringi rice mix. The company was formerly known as Yukiguni Maitake Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd. in April 2025. Yukiguni Factory Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Minamiuonuma, Japan.
profiles.4462: Ishihara Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical products in Japan, Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through metal surface treatment agents and equipment, electronic materials, automotive chemical products, and industrial chemicals segments. The company provides plating chemicals that are used in the production of electronic components for use in computers, office equipment, mobile phones, and digital appliances; tin and solder plating additives; and automatic control equipment for chemicals used in printed wiring board, plastic plating, flat-panel display, and plating process. It also offers welding chemicals; involved in the research and development of copper nano-particles and inks; electronic materials, such as submicron nickel powders for manufacturing of capacitor electrodes; ceramic materials, including machinable and engineering ceramics; and ceramic parts, which are used in various components and fixtures, such as semiconductor and LCD manufacturing equipment. In addition, the company develops, manufactures, and sells automotive chemicals under the Unicon brand, including car wash detergents for use at gas stations; maintenance chemicals for use at automotive inspection and repair shops, and FMC compounds and repair chemicals for use at body shops; car polish; finishing compounds; wash detergents; deodorant and sanitizer; and anti-spatter agents for welding, as well as consumer products for resale at automotive and other shops. Further, it distributes inorganic compounds and fine chemicals, including acids, alkalis, catalysts, and inorganic compounds. Ishihara Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1900 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
profiles.4931: Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. engages in developing and selling cosmetics and healthcare products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Mail Order, Wholesale Sales, and Overseas Sales segments. It offers health food, such as supplements and green juice, as well as healthcare products that include medicine. The company also provides skincare products under the Perfect One, Perfect One Focus brands, Fun&Health, and TONOU brands; and pharmaceutical products for various diseases and symptoms. In addition, it operates a network of stores and online shops. Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shinnihonliving Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. in April 2002. Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Fukuoka City, Japan.
profiles.8011: Sanyo Shokai Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of men's and women's clothes and accessories in Japan. The company sells its products through department stores, specialty stores, and directly managed stores. Sanyo Shokai Ltd. was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.7864: Fuji Seal International, Inc. engages in planning, proposal, development, manufacturing, and sales of packaging systems. The company offers shrink sleeve labels for containers; pressure sensitive labels used in promotional and advertising campaign tools; spouted pouches; rotary machines, linear machines, hybrid steam tunnels, self-adhesive/pressure-sensitive labelers, and PSL labeling systems; and packaging services, as well as training and maintenance services, after-service support services, and remote service centers. It also provides Deep IS, a security system that utilizes the slight, naturally occurring fluctuations in printing. The company operates in Japan, the United States, Mexico, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Spain, Poland, Switzerland, Germany, Italy, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, and India. The company was formerly known as Fuji Seal, Inc. and changed its name to Fuji Seal International, Inc. in 2004. Fuji Seal International, Inc. was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
profiles.7537: Marubun Corporation distributes electronics products in Japan and internationally. The company offers semiconductors and electronic components, including amplifiers, clocks, wired and wireless interfaces, isolation products, microcontroller processors, motor drivers, power supplies, RF and microwave, sensors, ASIC/FPGA/PLDs, memories, displays, ASSP, discrete products, protective elements, passive components, connector and switches, circuit boards and heat sinks. It also provides software products, such as cloud, enterprise software, embedded software, security, and OS and development tools; measuring equipment, tester monitoring, display/DLP, and others; inspection and analysis equipment, and other products; ICT solutions, including network and storage devices, simulator tester, server, equipment, security, and others; and assembly and robotics comprising assembly and mounting equipment, industrial robots, service robots, and others. In addition, the company offers laser and optical parts, such as laser, LED/light lamp, and others; embedded computer products, including CPU board, embedded system, and others; and other devices comprising IP/license, embedded module, driving simulator, RF and microwave components, and solar/solar cell system. Further, it provides medical devices; and outsourcing, seminars, acceptance testing, and maintenance services. Marubun Corporation was founded in 1844 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
profiles.8338: Tsukuba Bank, Ltd. provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company also offers deposits and loans; insurance; and asset management and consulting services. Tsukuba Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Tsukuba, Japan.
profiles.3962: CHANGE Holdings,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the digital transformation (DX) business in Japan. It operates through the NEW-IT Transformation Business and Publitech Business segments. The NEW-IT Transformation Business segment engages in the development of digital human resources, business processes, digitalization, as well as mergers and acquisitions brokerage and cybersecurity; engages in business process outsourcing business; provides robotic solutions and location information visualization service; digital transformation consulting and business design; productivity improvement, SaaS, and data utilization; and local government digital transformation, AI support, and system development. The Publitech Business segment is involved in regional revitalization and public sector digital transformation; engages in hometown tax donation, tourism, and carbon credits; tourism consulting; and inbound business. The company was formerly known as Change Inc. and changed its name to CHANGE Holdings,Inc. in April 2023. CHANGE Holdings,Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.2220: Kameda Seika Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells rice crackers and snacks in Japan and internationally. It produces rice flour bread; and offers plant-based and long-term preservation food, and rice congee. The company offers its products under the KAMEDA Kaki no Tane, Tsumami Dane, Kameda Usuyaki, Happy Turn, KAMEDA Magari Senbei, Potapota Yaki, Soft Salad, Age-Ichiban, Teshioya, Waza no KodaWari, Katabutsu, and HaiHain brand names. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.
profiles.3431: Miyaji Engineering Group,Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and civil engineering activities in Japan. It is involved in the designing, production, erection, installation, maintenance, and repair of bridges, steel frames, and other steel structures; design and production of prestressed concrete; and design, manufacture, installation, sale, and repair of bridges, coastal structures, etc. The company also designs, manufactures, and installs steel structures; sells bolts and welding materials; and offers temporary staffing services, and other business operations, as well as solar power generation activities. Miyaji Engineering Group,Inc. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
profiles.7921: Takara & Company Ltd. operates disclosure-related businesses, and interpretation and translation businesses in Japan. It produces, consults, prints, and translates disclosure and IR-related materials. The company offers project proposal, design creation, proofreading, printing, electronic, and other services for statutory disclosure documents; and voluntary disclosure documents created for shareholders and investors. It is also involved in the provision of support services for general shareholders meetings; creation of examples; and provision of various information and seminars for persons in charge of disclosure, as well as for acquiring certifications. In addition, the company develops and offers automation tools; WizLaboBudget, a budget management support tool; support services for the preparation of listing application documents required for initial public offering companies and support for audit responses; and advisory services related to the creation of ESG and integrated reports that create corporate social value, as well as develops applications and systems, corporate sites, such as ER/SR tools. Further, it provides support services for the transition to IFRS disclosure; disclosure of corrections and settlement of accounts and early settlement of accounts; advisory services, such as M&A support and listing examinations services on the TOKYO PRO Market; translation services covering a range of fields, including translation of confidential information and IR materials related to M&A; localization services; and support for customers global business development. Additionally, the company develops and sells AI translation systems, and support in setting up the translation environment. Takara & Company Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.8142: Toho Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the food wholesale, cash and carry, and supermarket businesses primarily in Japan. It is involved in the development, procurement, and purchase of commercial food; and manufacture of coffee. The company also engages in the wholesale of commercial foods, Chinese food ingredients, Japanese ingredients, fresh fruit, meat, and fruits and vegetables to the restaurant industry; dairy products, confectionery and baking materials; and sells broiler chickens and other domestically produced chicken meat. In addition, it is involved in the interior design and construction of restaurants; software development and maintenance; and general construction contracting, real estate management, and outsourcing of clean, on-demand, and general affairs works, as well as insurance agency activities. Further, the company engages in the import, manufacture, sale, and maintenance of commercial cooking equipment, coffee and ice cream machines, confectionery equipment, etc., as well as quality control services. The company was incorporated in 1929 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
profiles.8007: Takashima & Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, proposal, process, material sale, and distribution of construction and building products in Japan. The company offers wall materials, foundation piles, insulation materials, solar panels, interiors, and various other products related to construction and building. it also provides construction management services; textile and resin products; textile materials; sales promotion materials; apparel products; motor vehicle related parts and materials; wood products, rubber goods; environmentally friendly products; and industrial materials. In addition, it offers refrigerant gas for air conditioner, freezer, refrigeration equipment, and other products. Takashima & Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Takashimaya Kogyou Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takashima & Co., Ltd. in 1949. Takashima & Co., Ltd. was founded in 1915 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.6330: Toyo Engineering Corporation engages in the engineering and construction of industrial facilities in Japan, India, China, and internationally. It also provides various services, such as research and development support, planning, technical research, design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical assistance for industrial facilities, including oil and gas, petrochemicals and chemicals, water treatment, power generation, advanced production systems, pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals, biotechnology, environmental solutions, resource development, artificial intelligence. Toyo Engineering Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.
profiles.7034: Prored Partners CO.,LTD. provides management consulting services to companies in Japan. It offers cost management, strategy and hands-on consulting, PE fund support/PMI, SCM/logistics, and organizational strategy consulting services. The company also provides SaaS/IT services for PRO sign corporate real estate sector. Prored Partners CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
profiles.2148: ITmedia Inc. engages in the internet media business in Japan. It operates through B to B Media Business and B to C Media Business segments. The company offers lead generation, digital events, premium advertising and brand solutions, and programmatic advertising services. It also provides TechTarget Japan and Keyman’s Net for IT news, resources, and membership programs for the installation and purchase of IT products and services; Hacchu Navi for online matching services of IT products, services, and companies; ITmedia marketing for digital marketing trends, products, and services; @ IT for specialized IT information; ITmedia NEWS, ITmedia Enterprise, ITmedia Executive, and ITmedia AI+ for IT news and resources for corporate IT systems; ITmedia Business online for commentary on business news and information to improve work productivity; MONOist for technology explanations and membership programs in the assembly manufacturing field; EE Times Japan and EDN Japan for semiconductor and electronics technology explanations and membership programs; and TechFactory for news, resources, and membership programs for manufacturing companies. In addition, the company offers BUILT for the building and construction industry; Smart Japan for news and resources for the consideration and introduction of energy saving, energy storage, and electricity generation; online exhibitions and seminars; and consulting services on the sale of overseas exhibition reports and marketing. Further, it provides ITmedia Mobile and ITmedia PC USER for news, updates, and reviews on PCs, smartphones, AV equipment, and other digital devices; Fav-Log by ITmedia for purchasing support information for general daily necessities; and Netolabo for internet tips. The company was formerly known as Softbank ITmedia, Inc. and changed its name to ITmedia Inc. in March 2005. ITmedia Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. ITmedia Inc. operates as a subsidiary of SB Media Holdings Corp.
profiles.5232: Sumitomo Osaka Cement Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cement and related products primarily in Japan. It operates through six segments: Cement, Mineral Products, Building Materials, Optoelectronics, New Materials, and Others. The company offers cement, cement-based solidification materials, electric power supply, recycling, and ready-mix concrete; limestone for steelmaking, road construction, aggregate, calcium carbonate, dolomite, antibacterial agents, cosmetic materials, various functional paints, and silica powder; optical communication components and measuring equipment; and ceramic products and nanoparticle materials. It is also involved in repair and reinforcement materials for concrete structures, heavy metal pollution control materials, cathodic protection (ELGARD SYSTEM), and fish reefs and seaweed beds; and real estate leasing, information processing services, and electrical construction work which utilize idle land. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.6737: EIZO Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells visual display systems, amusement monitors, and imaging system software in Japan and internationally. It provides LCD, color management, and home entertainment monitors; operating room solutions; and medical monitor solutions. The company also offers industrial monitors; and ATC visual display solutions, such as primary control monitors, tower monitors, encoding and streaming solutions, data capture and content management solutions, and graphics boards, as well as other accessories. In addition, it provides business enterprise, healthcare, creative work, security and surveillance, touch panel, maritime, air traffic control, and home entertainment solutions. The company was formerly known as Eizo Nanao Corporation and changed its name to EIZO Corporation in 2013. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Hakusan, Japan.
profiles.9991: Gecoss Corporation rents and sells construction machinery and steel products in Japan. The company is involved in the rental and sale of temporary construction materials, such as H-shaped steel, steel sheet piles, iron plates, covering plates, and earth retaining materials. It also design, manufactures and sells erection and demolition work of mountain retaining and gantry, pile driving and pulling work, and obstacle removal work; rents, sells, and manufactures temporary bridges, station building platforms, stairs, shield mounts, road bridges, and bridge fall prevention hardware; rents cars; and rents construction equipment, such as aerial work platforms, backhoe, generators, light temporary construction and unmanned construction robot. In addition, the company undertakes design and construction of pile punching work, erection and demolition, soil cement column wall construction, etc. Further, it provides planning and design, and technical support services for temporary construction works. Gecoss Corporation was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
profiles.7433: Hakuto Co., Ltd. procures and sells electronic materials, parts, and equipment in Japan, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Products Business, Electronics and Electrical Equipment Business, Chemicals Business, and Other Businesses segments. The company provides semiconductor devices; and electronic components comprising photovoltaic products, connectors, optical measurement, measurement system, cable solutions, video conferencing and TFT-LCD panel, environmental products, IAQ monitor, and RFID solutions, as well as EMI, electronic component, and thermal management solutions. It also offers electronic and electric equipment, including photovoltaic manufacturing equipment, semiconductor equipment, compound semiconductor equipment, equipment for FPD, nanotechnology equipment, vacuum systems and components, optical equipment, scientific equipment, physics and water equipment, equipment for PWB and PCB, and optical network equipment. In addition, the company provides refinery chemicals, such as corrosion inhibitors, antifoulants, and emulsion breakers; petrochemicals that include polymerization inhibitors; pulp and paper chemicals comprising defoamers, deposit control aids/detergents, felt conditioners, biocides/preservatives, lime mud dewatering aids, and craping aids; cooling water treatment additives; boiler chemicals, such as oxygen scavengers, corrosion inhibitors, and boiler internal treatment chemicals; cosmetics, such as sunscreens, foundations, lotions, creams, cleansers, etc. under the TAEKO brand name; and automotive chemicals comprising over-sprayed detackifiers. Further, it involves in solar power generation business, contract work and other related businesses Hakuto Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
profiles.7599: IDOM Inc. engages in the sale of used cars in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the buying and selling used cars through a network of stores; and new car sales business. The company was formerly known as Gulliver International Co. Ltd. and changed its name to IDOM Inc. in July 2016. IDOM Inc. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
profiles.6222: Shima Seiki Mfg.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, sells, markets, and services knitting machines, design systems, and automatic fabric cutting machines in Japan, Europe, the Middle East, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers computerized flat, and glove and sock knitting machines under the WHOLEGARMENT brand; and peripherals. It also provides SDS-ONE APEX series, which consists of an all-in-one system, a design system with integrated hardware and software; and APEXFiz, a design software subscription service. In addition, the company offers P-CAM, a series of automatic fabric cutting machines; P-LAB automatic labeling machines; P-SPR 2 spreading machines; PMK 1600/2000 inkjet marking plotters; CAD/CAM systems; and SHIMA KnitManager, a production management software. Further, it is involved in the provision of service and maintenance services; manufacture of machine parts; production of cashmere yarns; sale of REPAC and ReMateri yarns; operation of BLUEKNIT, an online shopping mall for knits; Auberge de South Terrace, a hotel located in Nanki Shirahama; food services business; and operates Fusion museum. The company serves fashion, sports/outdoor, healthcare, shoes and accessories, home furnishings, automotive, aeronautical, and industrial materials industries. Shima Seiki Mfg.,Ltd. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Wakayama, Japan.
